item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00170","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C14","C01","C18"],"selected_candidate_label":"C14","confidence":0.94,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C14 plausibly supplied a material drafting template. Both orders suspend specified provisions of the Officer Personnel Act of 1947 for a defined officer group and use nearly identical operative syntax and the same distinctive termination formula tied to the fiscal year following the end of the December 16, 1950 national emergency. C01 and C18 are also close members of this drafting family, but C14 is the closest in language and temporal proximity.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the operation of the provisions of paragraph (2) of section 308 (b) of the Officer Personnel Act of 1947 ... is hereby suspended","parent_excerpt":"The operation of those provisions of Title III of the Officer Personnel Act of 1947, as amended ... is hereby suspended","explanation":"The same operative machinery suspends identified provisions of the same statute, with the statutory subsection and affected officer class adapted."},{"child_excerpt":"until June 30 of the fiscal year following that in which the national emergency proclaimed by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of December 16, 1950, shall end","parent_excerpt":"until June 30 of the fiscal year following that in which the national emergency proclaimed by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of December 16, 1950, shall end","explanation":"This distinctive termination clause is reproduced essentially verbatim."}]}
